Backend: 14/14 NEW pytests in test_iter24_plays.py PASS covering library (6 plays, exactly 1 available, audience split 3/3), start (idempotency, locked stub 400), list/get, advance to completion (5x → status='completed' + completed_at, 6th 400), jump (forward 409 without confirm, 200 with confirm, backward 200), pause/resume, exit, and PATCH state deep-merge. Frontend smoke (Bramuel → /app/plays): library renders 6 cards with correct data-testid='plays-card-{type}', only board_pack has data-testid='plays-start-board_pack', side-nav 'Plays' link present (between Cycle and Learn). ui_bugs.issue: After clicking data-testid='play-pause' on an active play, the button did NOT toggle to data-testid='play-resume' within 2s. Backend POST .../pause returns 200 with status='paused' (verified in pytest), so this is a frontend state-sync bug — the local play state likely isn't being refreshed after the pause mutation, or the conditional render keys off the wrong field. Re-loading the page would probably show the Resume button. Worth a quick re-test after fix.

issues: The Setting-the-cycle card renders a 'STAGE 1' kicker as the eyebrow label. Per AKKI v4.4 cadence spec ('no step counter, no "Stage 2 of 6" style copy'), 'STAGE 1' is a borderline step counter even without the 'of 6' suffix. Recommend replacing with 'BOARD PACK PLAY · SETTING THE CYCLE' or just dropping the eyebrow — the play-header already names the play and current stage. Same likely applies to other stage components in BoardPackStages.jsx — please grep for 'STAGE \d' or similar kickers.

action_items: Fix PlayView pause→resume button toggle: ensure local play state is updated (or re-fetched) after POST /pause and POST /resume so the conditional renders flip between data-testid='play-pause' and data-testid='play-resume' without a page reload.

Cadence audit: review BoardPackStages.jsx stage-primary kicker copy. 'STAGE 1' / 'STAGE 2' etc. read as a step counter — replace with the play name or drop the eyebrow. The play-header already carries 'BOARD PACK PLAY' + the stage name.

Confirm there is no stray 'Checklist' / progress-dot / percentage copy on any stage component (the keyword 'checklist' appeared somewhere in body innerText during the audit — could be unrelated nav copy but worth a quick visual sweep of all 6 BoardPackStages components).
critical_code_review_comments: plays.py:262 — completion trigger is `nxt >= len(stages) - 1` which fires when entering stage idx 5 (the 'done' stage). Confirmed correct via pytest (5 advances from 0 → stage 5 + completed). Subtle: if a future Play has fewer stages this off-by-one logic still holds, but using `nxt == len(stages) - 1` would be clearer than `>=`.
plays.py: idempotency on start_play correctly scopes to (context_id, account_id, play_type, status in active|paused). Completed/exited plays do NOT block a fresh start — verified.

plays.py PATCH state is a SHALLOW merge ({**old, **new}), not deep. The router docstring says 'deep-merges'. For Slice 1 stage state (flat keys like report_id, schedule_id) this is fine, but the docstring is misleading. Either fix the docstring or implement a real deep-merge for nested dicts.

plays.py: write_audit only fires on play.started and play.exited. The advance / jump / pause / resume / state_patched events go into the embedded play.events array but are NOT in the global audit_log. Fine for Slice 1 (the executive owns the play), but for Slice 2+ (Team Reporting Play with reportees) consider auditing every transition.
router: no rate limit / spam guard on PATCH /state. A buggy front-end could write thousands of events into the play.events array. Consider a soft cap (last 200) once Slice 2 ships.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% — library, navigation, header/stages/transitions, home strip all GREEN; pause→resume toggle did not flip in-page (1 issue); 'STAGE 1' kicker borderline cadence violation (1 design issue)
